Notes

  • Linked Rule in Detail Modal: The "Linked Reward Rule" section doesn't appear because the campaign's base_rule_id is null from the API. The UI is implemented — it will show once the backend populates this field on campaign creation.
  • Performance Stats: Campaign Performance shows dashes (—) as the backend doesn't have a campaign-specific performance endpoint yet. The grid layout matches the design spec.
  • Console errors: Only 2 — missing favicon.png (404) and campaign-config endpoint returning 404 for the current merchant. Neither affects functionality.
